title: Linux mkdir Command: Directory Creating
overview: Command-line practice: Linux mkdir Command: Directory Creating

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice Linux mkdir Command: Directory Creating. Use the prepared private Linux environment. Explanations and checks here are locally authored from the linked public requirements.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành Lệnh mkdir: tạo thư mục. Dùng terminal Linux riêng của bài. Hướng dẫn và bộ kiểm tra local được biên soạn lại theo yêu cầu công khai đã liên kết.


sections.title: Combining Options
sections.content:
Create research_paper/drafts and references under projects using -pvm 750.

```bash
mkdir -pvm 750 /home/labex/project/digital_garden/projects/research_paper/drafts /home/labex/project/digital_garden/projects/research_paper/references
```

sections.content:

```bash

```
